Other recorded qualifications

Statements this review records about the limits of what it establishes, which are not shown elsewhere on this page. They are reproduced from the object verbatim and are not summarised.

Table 12. Other recorded qualifications
The seventh reading was an amendmentSix readings were fixed before any count existed. The screen then surfaced a population none of them covered -- established atherosclerotic disease with no named vascular bed -- and ASCVD_MIXED was added as a dated amendment rather than folded back into the original six.
Why it is not reported as the resultThe three primaries differ by a whole component and by three qualifiers. Averaging them produces a number for a quantity no trial measured.
Why absentk=3 and nothing was pooled, so there is NO model call to quote, NO pooled estimate, NO heterogeneity and NO package version. This is not a missing artefact; it is the correct state for a topic with no synthesis.
LoDoCo2 is not in the registry arithmeticLoDoCo2 contributes an estimate and is not among the 137, because it is not registered on ClinicalTrials.gov. It is therefore not counted in the registry cascade and is counted in the contributing set. Two denominators, kept apart on purpose: folding it into the registry counts would make them stop reconciling and hide the reason.
And the registration count is not a study countNCT04906720 and NCT06731595 are one trial under two registration ids -- identical official title, org identifier, enrolment 248, dates, status and conditions. 137 is a count of registrations and at most 136 studies.
Boundary criterionPeriproc before coronary, and it is defined by what the primary outcome is -- a complication of an operation or catheter procedure -- never by a procedure having occurred. Clear synergy randomises myocardial-infarction patients undergoing PCI, so a 'was a procedure involved' rule would have taken the largest trial in this review out of it.
Pubmed remainder is not screened and that is declaredThe 523 PubMed records establish the denominator and recall. No disposition has been applied to any of them. Three publications were read; 520 were not. This is an unscreened remainder on the PubMed limb and it is stated rather than reported as zero -- E9, absence of a count is not a count of zero.
What blocks a pool at every rank that was readNamed, not general. (1) cardiovascular death is the one component all three share, and only colcot publishes it separately -- 1 of 3. (2) LoDoCo2's key secondary is the nearest thing to a common estimand and neither of the other two reports that composite at all -- 1 of 3. (3) clear synergy reports its components in words and not in numbers, so it cannot join any component-level pool from this source. The blocker is clear synergy's reporting, and it is the largest of the three. Reading its full text is the single action that would change this page's answer.
And one of those was wrong in this repositoryPUBLISHED_META_BENCHMARKS.json recorded LoDoCo2 as PMID 32865375. That PMID is EAST-AFNET 4, an atrial-fibrillation trial this corpus already cites correctly on two other pages. Corrected 2026-08-19; DEFECT-REGISTRY class 22.
LoDoCo2 cannot be checked this wayIt has no ClinicalTrials.gov identifier, and this computation keys on NCT ids. Its sharing status is not assessable by this method rather than false.

Introduction

Background. This review asks: Does low-dose colchicine reduce major adverse cardiovascular events in patients with established coronary artery disease or after myocardial infarction? It examines 3 randomised trials and does not pool them, against placebo in all three. The outcome sought is Major adverse cardiovascular events, as each trial defines them.1

Sources for this section (1)
  1. manuscript.introduction

Methods — search

Searches were executed in ClinicalTrials.gov API v2 on 2026-08-19 with the query, verbatim: intervention="colchicine"; condition="coronary artery disease OR myocardial infarction OR cardiovascular disease OR stroke OR atherosclerosis"; study_type=interventional; page_size=100; count_total=true. It returned 137 record(s).1

Searches were executed in PubMed on 2026-08-19 with the query, verbatim: colchicine and (cardiovascular OR coronary OR "myocardial infarction" OR stroke OR atherosclerosis) and (randomized controlled trial[Publication Type] OR randomised OR randomized). It returned 523 record(s).2

No search was executed against anzctr for this topic.3

Primary trials. No bibliographic search for primary trials was run. The 3 included trials were identified by reading named registrations on the dates recorded on each entry.4

Methods — eligibility criteria

Predefined: no. Derived post hoc on 2026-08-19 when colchicine-cvd-review was split into seven readings. A trial is in this reading when its population is established coronary artery disease or recent myocardial infarction, read from the coded conditions and, where those name something true but not the population's vascular disease, from the trial's own title with the fallback recorded. It is eligible when colchicine is the randomised contrast, the allocation is randomized, and the registration declares at least two arms. A precedence rule assigns every record to exactly one reading and it is published in full on this page, because a rule that decides inclusion and is published nowhere is not a criterion but a habit.1

Results

Major adverse cardiovascular events, as each trial defines them. These 3 trials are not pooled, and the reason is stated rather than the outcome being quietly omitted: The three trials do not share an endpoint. Decomposed into components and compared as sets rather than by name, the union is TEN components and exactly one -- cardiovascular death -- is common to all three. Resuscitated cardiac arrest is in colcot and in neither of the others: a whole component present in one arm of the comparison and absent from the rest. Myocardial infarction is any in colcot, spontaneous (nonprocedural) only in LoDoCo2, and recurrent in clear synergy -- and LoDoCo2's qualifier excludes periprocedural infarction in a literature where a large share of infarctions are periprocedural. Stroke is any type in colcot and clear synergy and ischaemic only in LoDoCo2; colchicine's effect in intracerebral haemorrhage is an open question with its own reading in this split, so a trial counting only ischaemic strokes and a trial counting every stroke are measuring the drug against different risks. Revascularisation requires an urgent hospitalisation for angina in colcot, is ISCHAEMIA-DRIVEN in LoDoCo2, and is unplanned and ischaemia-driven in clear synergy. A pool of these three would report a number for a quantity no trial measured. And, recorded separately on the withdrawal itself: no shared estimand -- see the recorded reason this pool was declined1

Sources for this section (1)

Limitations

What this review does not give a clinician: the number of events in each arm and any absolute effect or number needed to treat. A relative effect cannot be turned into the benefit or the risk facing one patient without them, so this review can support a judgement about what these trials found and not a judgement about what to do.1

what_the_drop_from_42_to_3_meansIT IS A FINDING OF THE SEARCH, NOT OF THE SCREEN. Thirty-nine eligible trials have run or are running and have published no primary result this pass could read. Per PAGE-STANDARD.md a body of eligible-but-unreported trials means the query is well aimed and the field is still in flight -- and the disposition split sharpens it: 53 of the 137 are COMPLETED, TERMINATED or WITHDRAWN with NOTHING posted to the registry, against 33 that have genuinely not reported yet. Those two states were separated deliberately, because folded together they read as a field still in flight when half of it is not.
and_the_registration_count_is_not_a_study_countNCT04906720 and NCT06731595 are ONE trial under two registration ids -- identical official title, org identifier, enrolment 248, dates, status and conditions. 137 is a count of REGISTRATIONS and at most 136 studies.

Analysis output — ABSENT_AND_THAT_IS_THE_FINDING

k=3 and nothing was pooled, so there is NO model call to quote, NO pooled estimate, NO heterogeneity and NO package version. This is not a missing artefact; it is the correct state for a topic with no synthesis.

What stands instead: —
Provenance: —
—

Heterogeneity: Undefined: no between-study variance was estimated because no model was run.
What would change it: An estimand shared by two or more included trials. Where k is already above 1 and nothing pooled, the obstacle is the ESTIMAND rather than the evidence base, and this field must say which.

Published-meta comparison — PENDING_EXTERNAL_RESOLUTION

Denominator: —. Not yet established. Establishing it requires resolving published syntheses' included-sets to REGISTRATION IDs. A second lane has validated that pipeline (stated-k table identification plus two-hop citation->PMID->registration) and is running it now.

Explicitly not done: CITATION-STRING MATCHING. It would produce a comparison-shaped answer tonight and it is not identity: two syntheses citing the same trial under different labels would read as different, and the same label on different trials as the same. That is the substitution class this project audits for.

Blocked on: lane 2 registration-id resolution
